in_arabic.name: صفين
in_arabic.meaning: الذين يسيرون في صف مستقيم، صفوف المجاهدين في سبيل الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم صفين مشتق من كلمة صف، ويشير إلى الذين يسيرون في صف مستقيم، كصفوف المجاهدين في سبيل الله، كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الصافات، الآية  صفًا واحدًا  وهم الذين يجعلون صفوفهم متسقة في الصلاة أو في المعركة، ويدل على الانضمام والتوحيد في الهدف.

in_urdu.name: صفیون
in_urdu.meaning: جو صف میں چلتے ہیں، سیدھا چلنے والے، مجاہدین فی سبیل اللہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: صفیون نام کا مطلب ہے جو لوگ سیدھا چلتے ہیں یا صف میں چلنے والے، خاص طور پر مجاہدین جو اللہ کی راہ میں لڑتے ہیں، اس کا تعلق عربی جڑ ص ف ف سے ہے، جو سیدھا کھڑے ہونے یا ایک قطار میں کھڑے ہونے کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے، یہ نام مسلمانوں میں خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیا میں مقبول ہے کیونکہ یہ توحید اور نظم و ضبط کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: सफीयुन
in_hindi.meaning: जो लोग सीधे चलते हैं, सच्चे योद्धे, मुजाहिदीन फी سبيل الله
in_hindi.long_meaning: सफीयुन नाम का अर्थ है जो लोग सीधे चलते हैं या एक पंक्ति में चलने वाले लोग, विशेष रूप से मुजाहिदीन जो अल्लाह की राह में लड़ते हैं, इसकी जड़ अरबी शब्द صف से है, जो सीधे खड़े होने या एक पंक्ति में खड़े होने की ओर इशारा करता है, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में लोकप्रिय है क्योंकि यह एकता और अनुशासन का प्रतीक है।

in_english.name: Safeeyun
in_english.meaning: those who walk in a straight line, righteous warriors
in_english.long_meaning: The name Safeeyun is derived from the Arabic root ص ف ف (s-ṣ-f), which means to stand in a straight line or to form a row, it refers to those who walk in a straight line, particularly the righteous warriors or martyrs who stand united in the cause of Allah, mentioned in the Quranic context of maintaining unity and discipline, this name holds significant spiritual and cultural value in Islamic tradition, symbolizing unity, righteousness, and the pursuit of a noble cause.

data.cultural_impact: The name Safeeyun holds great significance in Islamic culture as it signifies a person who acts as a guardian, protector, and caretaker for others. In a community-driven religion such as Islam, where kinship and the welfare of the Muslim ummah (community) are highly valued, names like Safeeyun carry a heavy load of responsibility and are considered to be a mark of honor. Safeeyun is a name bestowed upon individuals who embody the spirit of seniority, wisdom, and strong moral character. They serve as role models for young members of the community and are constantly striving to uphold the virtues of compassion, courage, and selflessness that the name entails.
data.spiritual_significance: In terms of spiritual significance, the name Safeeyun is deeply rooted in the teachings of Islam and serves as a constant reminder of the religious responsibility to protect and care for others. As Muslims believe in the concept of a loving and compassionate God, the name Safeeyun can be seen as an embodiment of Allah's divine protection and guidance. The name also reflects the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) emphasis on the importance of mutual support and brotherhood within the Muslim community. The deposit of such a name can serve as a source of motivation and inspiration for its bearer to embody the virtues of kindness, empathy, and compassion towards others, and to constantly strive towards living an upright and dedicated life in the service of Allah and His community.
